title: French Equatorial Africa
capsule: Attested in our geometric sources A prior capsule was withdrawn in source review; an accurate one is pending.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. The federation's outer boundaries are well attested through French colonial administrative records; the 1842 start date in the atlas reflects early French treaty-making on the Gabon coast rather than the formal 1910 federation proclamation.
